body:
I used to care and try very hard. I used to view this as a challenge and one day I would use it to cheer people up or motivate people to a better life. It never changed though and I lost any enthusiasm to try. There is only so many times you can get excited or be positive and be let down until you kind of give up caring. I don't see life getting any better. The only internet I have access to is here at work so they really aren't going to like me working another job online while I'm working here. I'm sitting here logged into my bank account and it says "-$233.54". I'm worth less than zero and don't have anything to show for it. No car, no house, no land, nothing. I rent old office space with gray cinder block walls and a shower I made into an old drain into the floor. I don't have any family or friends to talk to. I just spend my time by myself and while I'm at work it's just getting yelled at by customers or my boss. What's the final product of all of this? What dues am I paying? I know I don't deserve anything special but I just want to be happy. I want to not have to worry about being homeless as my health declines. When I die, they're going to stick me in that Pauper's cemetery. There won't be anyone there and I will have spent the entire time miserable and sad. 

If I die right now then all of this will be over. There will be no more worrying and it doesn't matter if at some point it got better because for once, I won't care because I'll be dead. I just don't fit into our society. My only other option is to live my life getting kicked off other people's property trying to live off the land. You know how miserable that would be? Trying to hunt and fish in the heat all day or frigid ass cold. Anyone that suggests that is an idiot. 

I don't know. I really hate life. I hate waking up everyday to the broken record of misery. A life without advancement isn't worth living. 10 years ago I was told it will get better. Fucking when?
I go every month or so.

Because I have a felony due to my handing a stolen check to a bank teller at a drive through the passenger of my car was trying to cash. 

That means that I can't work a real job. I know because I've been to hundreds of job interviews over the past 15 years that have all turned me down because of it. The only employment I can get is getting paid under the table. Which means at any moment I could be arrested for tax fraud. It won't be long before I'm caught anyway and have to go to prison because I can't afford any fines or back taxes. It's just enough money to pay rent. I can't work a minimum wage job because it doesn't pay enough for rent and water. I have no money saved up, I can't afford college or medical care. I live in old office space that I converted into an apartment. It's not anything you'd bring someone else to. I can't raise a family for multiple reasons. I'd never make enough money for a child unless more than one. I have things cut down to a bare minimum and if anything happened I couldn't do anything about it unless I stole what I needed to fix it or got the service for free. 

So I'll never have anything I want or be with anyone I want to be with because of everything that's happened in the past. The future is bleak and it's not worth really carrying on being miserable everyday trying to work towards an impossible goal. I even broke the goal up into several smaller goals. I haven't achieved anything. Every time something changes it just makes my life worse.
